findings.statement: CA9 is tumor-cell intrinsic: RCC cells hold 0.976 of tumor transcripts (54.7% of RCC cells express it) and the pure-tumour RNA log2FC extrapolated to purity 1 is 7.787, so the bulk signal (log2FC 6.312) is not stromal.
In paired tumor cell vs proximal tubule pseudobulk CA9 has log2FC 7.739 (padj 0.0189, 6 donors), and TCGA-KIRC replicates it (log2FC 9.712), supporting a tumor-vs-cell-of-origin biomarker.
In Visium, CA9 expression is assigned to RCC spots (composition-corrected share 0.999) and high spots are enriched for RCC neighbours (log2 enrichment 0.381, padj 0.0017), i.e. a tumor-cell niche.

CA9 best MGD site score is 0.546 (pocket 126.8 A3, pLDDT 90.3, 1 accessible lysine, model mean pLDDT 76.56); ligand-site recall is 0.5 but only 0.221 within top pockets. This ranks a site, not a glue; the pocket is small and likely the catalytic zinc site.

CD70 is up in ccRCC (TCGA log2FC 7.09) and survives purity extrapolation (RNA log2FC at purity 1 of 4.278), consistent with tumor-intrinsic expression; clinical-stage antibodies exist (vorsetuzumab, cusatuzumab, up to phase 2). Single-cell shows some T/B-cell expression, so an off-tumor immune caveat applies.

NNMT is tumor-cell intrinsic: the RNA log2FC at purity 1 is 5.256 (bulk RNA log2FC 4.67, protein 2.709) and TCGA log2FC is 4.685, with adverse prognosis (Cox log HR 0.301); no clinical drug is listed.

KDR is an endothelial gene, not a tumor-cell target: endothelium holds 0.951 of tumor transcripts (40.5% of endothelial cells express it) and Visium shows endothelial composition-corrected share 0.99 versus 0.002 for RCC.

KDR has a high-scoring site (MGD 0.841, pocket 361.1 A3, 7 accessible lysines, mean pLDDT 71.12) but it acts on endothelium, so any glue would be a microenvironment/anti-angiogenic strategy; no ligand validation quoted here.

CD74 transcripts are immune: macrophages hold 0.436 and CD8 T cells 0.345 of tumor transcripts (cDC 0.114), and Visium assigns a composition-corrected share of 0.637 to macrophages, so the bulk signal is infiltrating immune cells, not tumor cells.
CXCR4 is expressed by lymphocytes: CD8 T cells hold 0.563 of tumor transcripts and CD4 T cells have the highest expressing fraction (87.8%), so it is an immune microenvironment target.
MET is mostly tumor-cell expressed: RCC cells hold 0.935 of tumor transcripts but only 35.2% of RCC cells express it (cpm_share 0.682); endothelium has 12% expressing cells.

EPAS1 transcripts in tumor are mostly non-tumor: endothelium holds 0.365 and fibroblasts 0.081 of transcripts, RCC cells only 0.051 (4.9% expressing), so EPAS1 is not a clean tumor-cell expression marker in this dataset.

COL23A1 is the top tumor-track first-in-class candidate: RCC cells hold 0.881 of tumor transcripts, 7 ccRCC papers, no clinical drug, AB/PR tractable, surface/secreted, max vital-organ nTPM 3 (heart muscle), TCGA log2FC 5.829, log2FC at purity 1 of 4.88. Hypothesis only: no dependency evidence (DepMap mean effect 0.167, not selective); literature counted by gene symbol. AlphaFold model is poor (mean pLDDT 58.91; best MGD site 0.2342, 8.0 A3), so not a glue candidate.

RAB42 is a second tumor-track candidate: RCC cells hold 0.627 of tumor transcripts, 2 ccRCC papers (20 total), no clinical drug, TCGA log2FC 4.371 and log2FC at purity 1 of 3.189; vital-organ max 2.6 nTPM (lung). Best MGD site is 0.5348 (37.4 A3, 3 accessible lysines, model pLDDT 85.31) with no ligand-site validation. Hypothesis; no functional or dependency evidence.

OLFML2A is a stroma-track candidate carried by fibroblasts (0.647 of tumor transcripts), 2 ccRCC papers, no clinical drug, antibody-tractable; TCGA log2FC 2.372, log2FC at purity 1 of 1.527. Vital-organ max 27.9 nTPM (colon) is an off-tumor caveat, and it targets the microenvironment rather than tumor cells. Hypothesis only.

JAG2 is an endothelial stroma-track candidate (0.487 of tumor transcripts), 9 ccRCC papers, no clinical drug, antibody-tractable; TCGA log2FC 1.549, log2FC at purity 1 of 1.061, TCGA survival layer present; vital-organ max 12.7 nTPM (heart muscle). Hypothesis; DepMap mean effect 0.204, not a selective dependency.

SLC37A2 is a macrophage immune-track candidate (0.886 of tumor transcripts), 2 ccRCC papers, no clinical drug, AB/PR tractable; TCGA log2FC 3.093 and log2FC at purity 1 of 0.619 (purity robust). Best MGD site 0.7403 (228.1 A3, depth 11.79, 4 accessible lysines, model pLDDT 83.94), ligand-site recall 1.0 from a single ligand. Immune-cell target; hypothesis only.

GAL3ST4 is a macrophage immune-track candidate (0.972 of tumor transcripts), 1 ccRCC paper, no clinical drug; TCGA log2FC 2.993 and adverse prognosis (Cox log HR 0.177), but log2FC at purity 1 is only 0.401. Best MGD site 0.7874 (819.7 A3, 5 accessible lysines, pLDDT 79.31). Hypothesis only; macrophage-restricted, not a tumor-cell target.

LILRB4 is flagged infiltration-driven: macrophages hold 0.933 of tumor transcripts, TCGA log2FC 3.7 but log2FC at purity 1 only 0.508 (not purity-robust), so its bulk up-regulation reflects immune infiltration rather than tumor-cell expression.

caveats: Discovery candidates are data-ranked hypotheses: concordant tumor-up expression does not show functional requirement; literature counts are by gene symbol; DepMap shows no selective dependency for the quoted genes.
MGD scores rank pockets only and do not imply a glue exists; several pockets are small (<130 A3) or have low-confidence models, and ligand-site recall from few ligands is weak evidence.

CD70 and NNMT single-cell and tumor-vs-PT values returned without evidence ids, so they are not quoted; their tumor-intrinsic claim rests on purity-extrapolated bulk data. Convergence top ranks ALDOB, SLC22A8, PIGR, UMOD, FABP1 are down in tumor (normal-tubule markers) and were not profiled at single-cell level.
EGFR was not profiled within the tool budget; tumour-cell scRNA has only one PT donor (39 cells) in some comparisons.
